unit: Córdobas (pre-1988) per 1 USD (córdoba nuevo converted back, ×1,000)
notes: "Operación Berta" (14 Feb 1988) replaced 1,000 córdobas with 1 córdoba nuevo; later points are converted back into old córdobas. Hyperinflation ran from June 1986 to March 1991 and peaked at 261% in March 1991 (Hanke & Krus). Approximate series, kept for its shape; individual points are not sourced one by one.
